mechanism_narrative: The sharp drop in WORKPLACES and TRANSIT at t-0w signals a broad stay-at-home shock that will continue to suppress discretionary shopping, so RETAIL_REC will remain below its prior 4-week mean over the next month.
failure_condition: If WORKPLACES and TRANSIT recover by at least 15 points from t-0w within 2 weeks and RETAIL_REC does not rise above its last-4-week mean, this mechanism is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: When TRANSIT falls below -45 and WORKPLACES stays below -60, retail access is constrained enough that shopping trips are deferred, causing RETAIL_REC to decline further over the next 1 to 2 weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT falls below -45 while WORKPLACES remains below -60
failure_condition: If the threshold is crossed but RETAIL_REC does not fall within the next 2 weeks relative to the last 2 weeks, the hypothesis fails.

mechanism_narrative: A rebound in GROCERY_PHARM usually precedes broader errand-based foot traffic; if this category stops falling and turns up, retail-and-recreation should improve over the following 4 weeks as mixed-purpose trips resume.
failure_condition: If GROCERY_PHARM remains at or below its t-0w level and RETAIL_REC still rises over the next 4 weeks, the proxy link is falsified.

mechanism_narrative: A large negative PARKS shock with simultaneous decline in RESIDENTIAL time indicates weather-driven or holiday-driven household sheltering; that pattern reduces discretionary outings and pushes RETAIL_REC lower within 1 week.
candidate_trigger: PARKS falls below -40 while RESIDENTIAL exceeds +20
failure_condition: If the combined PARKS and RESIDENTIAL pattern occurs and RETAIL_REC does not decline in the following week, the hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: The persistent rise in RESIDENTIAL combined with weakening WORKPLACES indicates substitution toward home-based activity, which will keep discretionary retail demand soft over the next 4 weeks.
failure_condition: If RESIDENTIAL stays elevated but WORKPLACES rebounds and RETAIL_REC nevertheless rises over the next 4 weeks, the substitution mechanism fails.

mechanism_narrative: A one-week collapse in RETAIL_REC is more likely to persist when all travel-related categories fall together; if TRANSIT, WORKPLACES, and PARKS each weaken, retail shopping will remain depressed over the next 2 weeks.
candidate_trigger: TRANSIT, WORKPLACES, and PARKS all decline week-on-week
failure_condition: If all three proxies decline but RETAIL_REC rebounds within 2 weeks, the joint-shock hypothesis is rejected.

mechanism_narrative: In a reopening regime, modest improvement in TRANSIT and WORKPLACES signals more commuting and more incidental shopping, so RETAIL_REC should rise over the next 4 weeks even if current levels remain below baseline.
failure_condition: If TRANSIT and WORKPLACES improve over the next month but RETAIL_REC stays below its last-4-week mean, the mechanism is invalid.

mechanism_narrative: When PARKS and GROCERY_PHARM both drop sharply, the city is likely experiencing a weather or holiday shock that suppresses all outside trips; retail visits should then fall further within 1 to 2 weeks.
candidate_trigger: PARKS falls below -30 and GROCERY_PHARM falls below -15
failure_condition: If both proxies cross the trigger but RETAIL_REC does not decline over the next 2 weeks, the seasonal-shock hypothesis fails.
